full_prompt_en: A whimsical pen-and-watercolor illustration shows an inventor seated at a cluttered workbench while a yellow dog waits on the tiled floor behind him. The inventor, seen mostly from the back in a blue sweater, studies a small screen beneath a suspended blue model airplane. A red airship hangs higher near the sloping ceiling. Shelves, pipes, boxes, tools, little machines, bottles, and papers crowd the walls and benches, giving the room the feel of an eccentric private workshop. Yet a broad patch of pale floor opens in the foreground and lets the eye reach the desk. Fine brown-black ink lines describe every drawer, wire, and bracket with cheerful persistence. Transparent watercolor settles within the linework in muted blue, gray-green, straw yellow, rust red, and warm stone. The pigment is lightly uneven and speckled, so off-white paper remains visible between marks. Soft ambient light enters from the left and gently brightens the inventor's pale hair and the floor tiles; shadows are delicate, mostly gathered beneath the bench and inside the stacked objects. A curved ceiling at upper left frames the space, while the long right-side shelf angles inward toward the seated figure. The bright dog forms a simple warm punctuation against the cooler, densely worked background. The scene is detailed without becoming severe: tiny plausible mechanisms reward close inspection, while generous hand-drawn irregularity keeps the mood patient, curious, and gently comic.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅俏皮的钢笔水彩插画描绘一位发明家坐在拥挤工作台前，一只黄狗在他身后的瓷砖地面等待。发明家主要以背影出现，穿蓝毛衣，在悬挂的蓝色模型飞机下看着小屏幕。更高处的斜天花板旁挂着红色飞艇。架子、管道、盒子、工具、小机器、瓶子和纸张塞满墙面与工作台，让房间像一间古怪的私人工作室。然而前景一大片浅色地面敞开，让目光能到达书桌。细棕黑墨线以愉快的耐性描出每个抽屉、电线和支架。透明水彩在墨线内沉成低饱和蓝、灰绿、稻黄、锈红与暖石色。颜料略不均且带细点，笔痕之间仍露出米白纸。柔和环境光从左侧进入，轻轻照亮发明家的浅发与地砖；阴影细弱，主要聚在桌下和堆叠物内部。左上弯曲天花板框住空间，右侧长架朝坐着的人斜向深入。明亮的狗在较冷而密集刻画的背景前成为简单的暖色停顿。场景细节繁多却不严肃：微小而可信的机制值得近看，充分的手绘不规则感仍保持耐心、好奇且温和喜剧的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Whimsical pen-and-watercolor illustration layers very fine brown-black contour over transparent, slightly speckled color on warm off-white paper. Countless small lines articulate complex local texture, but a broad pale opening in the foreground preserves an easy route into the image. Muted blue and gray-green dominate the worked areas; straw yellow, rust red, and warm stone provide selective accents. Linework stays precise enough to describe tiny joints and compartments, yet every edge wavers gently with the hand. Washes vary in density and let paper grain show through, while darker crosshatched pockets collect under overlaps. Soft ambient light comes from one side and produces mild shadows rather than hard contrast. Curved upper framing and long diagonal shelves or bands can guide attention toward a compact center. An isolated warm shape gives the eye a resting point among the crowded details. The overall rhythm moves between intricate miniature clusters and generous quiet surfaces, conveying patient curiosity and light comic charm.
style_prompt_zh: 俏皮的钢笔水彩插画把极细棕黑轮廓叠在暖米白纸上的透明、略带色点的颜料之上。无数小线条刻出繁密局部纹理，但前景宽阔浅色空处仍保留轻松进入画面的通道。低饱和蓝与灰绿主导密画区域，稻黄、锈红与暖石色选择性点缀。线稿足够精确，能描述微小连接与格室，却让每道边缘都有轻微手工摇摆。罩染浓淡变化并透出纸粒，较暗的交叉排线口袋聚在叠压处。柔和环境光从一侧来到，只造出温和阴影，不形成硬对比。上方弯曲框架与长斜架或斜带可引导注意力到紧凑中心。孤立暖色形状让眼睛在拥挤细节间获得停顿。整体节奏在复杂微型簇与宽阔安静表面之间游走，传出耐心的好奇与轻巧漫画魅力。
theme_en: An inventor and a dog in a cluttered aircraft workshop
theme_zh: 发明家与狗置身堆满飞行器的工作室
name: Mattias Adolfsson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
